name: halftone-expansion
intent: Halftone dot field expands from trigger origin as a transition mask while swapping STANDBY zone A to COMPLETE zone B (and reverse on reset).

copy.liveStandby: Standby zone ready. Activate to expand.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Instant zone swap from trigger click; no halftone mask travel

acceptance: Activate expands halftone mask from button origin toward scaleMax 3.2 and swaps STANDBY to COMPLETE at coverMs 220
Reset reverses mask from button origin and restores ZONE A STANDBY copy
Origin vars --htx-ox/--htx-oy set from trigger centroid; scale frozen via --htx-scale-rest/--htx-scale-max
Mask remains clipped inside specimen bounds; polite aria-live announces expanding, contracting, and settled zone
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) swaps zones instantly with no mask visibility
Restart message resets to standby deterministically
